simple.meaning: גַּחַם (Gacham) is a Hebrew word meaning “Gacham , a son of Nahor.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.

definitions.full: H1514. Gacham גַּ֫חַם proper name, masculine ( flame ? ) Gen 22:24 a son of Nahor, brother of Abraham, by רְאוּמָה his concubine. גחן (compare Aramaic גְּחַן , Nasar. (Syriac PS) curve, bend ).
definitions.rootNote: from an unused root meaning to burn; flame;

occurrences.englishText: His concubine, whose name was Reumah, also bore Tebah, Gaham, Tahash, and Maacah.
